description: Jinny Lee is a dedicated real estate professional in East Auckland, helping homeowners achieve premium results and guiding buyers to secure the right property with confidence. Backed by Ray White Botany, Jinny combines strong local knowledge, strategic marketing, and a client-first approach.
tone: warm yet confident, trustworthy, knowledgeable, approachable, community-focused, client-first

brand_positioning.jinny_role: trusted East Auckland real estate advisor
brand_positioning.differentiation: local market expertise, strong negotiation skills, personalised service

target_audience.primary: homeowners in East Auckland looking to sell their property
target_audience.secondary: buyers and families searching for homes in East Auckland
target_audience.entry_level: first-home buyers needing guidance and education

content_pillars.details: how to sell smarter, pricing strategies, preparing homes, negotiation insights
how to buy better, market tips, open home advice, mistakes to avoid
suburb insights, schools, lifestyle, amenities, community highlights
new listings, sold results, behind-the-scenes of deals, case studies
day in the life, client interactions, personality-driven content
TikTok/IG trends adapted to real estate, relatable POV content

content_types.description: strong 1-3 second hook, problem or POV-based real estate scenario
quick actionable tips for homeowners preparing to sell
practical advice for buyers navigating the market
highlight property features with lifestyle angle
case study or story behind a successful sale
showcase East Auckland suburbs, lifestyle and amenities
viral or relatable content adapted to real estate

_note: TikTok can be added later once content strategy is consistent. Connect Instagram via Meta Business Manager.

optimal_times: 21:00 — top performing hour from Facebook insights, appearing in 2 of the top 5 posts; also aligns closely with the 20:00 consistent posting hour across all 4 archived local posts, suggesting evening scheduling is the established and preferred window
06:00 — second confirmed hour from Facebook insights top 5 posts, appearing in 2 of 5; suitable for morning commute reach on educational and market update content
20:00 — most common posting hour across all 4 archived local posts; retained as a fallback evening window closely aligned with the 21:00 insights peak
best_days: Tuesday through Thursday recommended as primary posting days for education and market content based on general real estate social media best practices — low confidence due to insufficient day-level performance data in current insights period
Saturday morning at 09:00 to 10:00 recommended for listing and open home content to align with weekend buyer browsing and open home activity in East Auckland
Sunday evening at 20:00 to 21:00 recommended for seller education and week-ahead market content targeting homeowners in a relaxed planning mindset
learned.image_to_text_ratio: 3:1 — minimum three image or video posts for every one text-only post per week; current archive is effectively 0:4 in favour of text which is the inverse of recommended best practice per brand identity guidelines and all five research briefs; this ratio shift is the most urgent tactical change required this period
top_content_types: listing — hero interior and exterior shots showcasing lifestyle, indoor-outdoor flow, and premium East Auckland homes (recommended as primary based on brand identity and research; low confidence due to zero image engagement data in current period)

lifestyle — family living moments, warm autumn-toned interiors, soft natural light through windows, indoor-outdoor connection (seasonal alignment with Autumn 2026 context confirmed across all five research briefs)

sold — celebration moments, sold sticker overlays, happy client handovers at front door with genuine emotion (social proof format cited across three separate research briefs as a trust-building driver of seller enquiries; absent from current archive and a priority gap to fill)

local_area — East Auckland streets, parks, school zones, suburban greenery, coastal lifestyle shots (community and suburb spotlight content noted across multiple research briefs as building local authority and trust consistently; currently absent from archive)

agent_brand — Jinny interacting with clients at open homes, behind-the-scenes of listing process, professional yet warm and approachable moments (transparency and personal brand content cited in April 23 research brief as trust-building during active market conditions)
top_pillars: Seller Education — autumn selling season is at peak relevance across all five research briefs; education posts on pricing, staging, listing preparation, and the cost of waiting are consistently cited as high-engagement save-and-share formats; this pillar should lead the weekly content mix

Trends and Short-form Content — short-form video under 30 seconds is flagged as the highest watch-through format in April 2026 across multiple research briefs; introducing at least one TikTok or Instagram Reel per week is the single highest-priority format gap to close given the current text-only archive

Personal Brand and Trust — behind-the-scenes listing process content and transparency posts cited in April 23 research brief as trust-building during active market conditions; sold celebration stories and client handover moments are absent from the current archive and should be introduced immediately

Listings and Success Stories — sold results and client success case studies cited across three research briefs as social proof drivers of seller enquiries; this format is entirely absent from the current 4-post archive and represents the most significant missed opportunity for trust conversion

voice_guide.headline_style: short punchy, 2–6 words, benefit-driven or curiosity-based
voice_guide.caption_style: hook first, value or story, then soft CTA — no hashtags in body

text_post_disclaimer: This post is for general information purposes only and does not constitute financial or property advice.
news_disclaimer: Disclaimer: This content is based on information from external sources believed to be reliable. It is not independently verified. Please refer to the original source for full details.

image_style.description: Clean, modern, premium real estate — lifestyle-driven and aspirational
photography_style: bright natural lighting with soft shadows
avoid: generic stock images with no local relevance
composition_rules: highlight key selling features (kitchen, living, outdoor flow)
ensure straight vertical lines for property shots
balance indoor and outdoor lifestyle elements
leave space for text overlays when needed
